Greenland. W-coast. Julianehåb bugt. Firing exercise.

Firing exercise

The 22nd November 2026 from 1100 to 1700 UTC a firing exercise will take place between pos. 60° 20.0'N - 046° 15.0'W and 59° 59.0'N - 045° 32.0'W and 59° 45.0'N - 046° 03.0'W and 60° 00.0'N - 046° 45.0'W. Sikkerhedshøjde 680 meters/ 2300 feet. Safety distance 11700 meters / 6.32 NM. Military vessels will be in the area listening on VHF CH 16. Mariners are requested to pass with caution.
